title: Activate ready domains and align hosted website canonicals

verify.note: Nine focused suites / 139 tests passed with inert provider/storage mocks, including readiness flags, stale candidate CAS, revoked authorization, existing-domain preservation, purchase staging, inherited chapter metadata and sitemap exclusion. Local source verification only; root owns full release checks and production verification. The bounded Node probe executes actual readiness/staging/activation source with inert storage; missing readiness and stale candidate/tenant/active binding consequences are asserted. Own-process fd3 CPU1644.768ms, under the existing4500ms probe budget.

detail: Manual and purchased domains stage in a public-safe preferences node while spaces.domain remains the active binding. Check again requires complete hosting/ownership/DNS/TLS readiness and fresh authorization, then compare-and-set matches both candidate and prior active binding. Pending cancellation preserves a working active domain. Metadata and sitemap share website canonical resolution, including published Network chapters with no direct domain. The Frequency sitemap omits aliases whose canonical belongs to a hosted website and retains app-only tabs. Existing active domains retain backward-compatible behavior; historical domain readiness needs separate release verification. No migration, provider mutation, purchase, DNS change or production data write performed. Existing preferences RPC is required; staging fails visibly when unavailable.
